page.title: Ebiyungo
page.intro: Gatta akawunti zo ez’okulanga. Leads okuva mu birango byo zituuka mu My Leads automatically, nga buli lead esaasaanya n’omuwendo.

connect.title: Yunga ku LinkedIn
connect.intro: Yingira ne akawunti ya LinkedIn eddukanya ebirango byo. Leadrat esoma akawunti zo ez’ebirango zokka, Lead Gen Form leads n’ebibalo by’ebirango, era n’eweereza enkyukakyuka z’okyusa.
connect.need1: Omulimu ku akawunti y’ebirango LinkedIn (Omulabi oba okusingawo).
connect.need2: Omulimu ku mukutu gwa kkampuni oguyungiddwa (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator oba Analyst) - LinkedIn yeetaaga okugabana abakulembeze.
connect.need3: Ekibuuzo ky'ennamba y'essimu ku Lead Gen Forms zo - leads ezitaliiko nnamba ya ssimu teziyinza kwongerwako.

connection.fetchTitle: Fetch leads okusinziira ku date range
connection.fetchHint: Lead empya zikeberebwa buli luvannyuma lwa ddakiika ntono ate ennaku 7 ezisembayo ziddamu okukeberebwa buli lunaku, kale tewali kisubwa. Kino kikozese ku leads okuva nga tonnayunga, oba okuddamu okukebera period (okutuuka ku nnaku 90 buli mulundi). Leads edda mu Leadrat zisimbulwa.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Buulira LinkedIn ani ku bakulembeze baayo eyafuuka abasuubira ddala. Omukulembeze LinkedIn bw’atuuka ku mbeera gy’olonze wansi, Leadrat akitegeeza LinkedIn , kale lipoota zo eza kampeyini ziraga omutindo gw’omukulembeze era LinkedIn esobola okufuna abantu bangi ng’abakulembeze bo abasinga obulungi. LinkedIn lead ID ne hash ey’engeri emu eya email byokka bye biweerezeddwa.
capi.noRules: Tewali mbeera ziteekeddwa ku maapu n'okutuusa kati.
capi.created: Okukyusa okutondebwa ku LinkedIn ne ku maapu.
